basic_info.description: Classic Marina style, central Sunset home offers 1600+ sq. ft. of living space (per tax record) on the main level with the possibility for vertical expansion and garden level addition. The property maintains its 1920's era charm boasting 2 bedrooms plus sunroom with large closets, barrel design living room, formal dining room, large eat-in kitchen with utility side door access, split bathroom, fantastic hardwood floors with in-lay and garage and driveway parking! Perfectly positioned at the West side of a great block on a large 25 X 120 lot located North of Judah Street close to Golden Gate Park and Irving Street shopping and dining! Excellent public transportation and easy freeway access for Downtown and South Bay commute.
